table.name: museum
table.purpose: Catalog of museums, one row per museum, with its name, staff size, and opening year. Referenced by the visit table (visits per museum).

Museum_ID.name: Museum_ID
Museum_ID.description: Primary key identifying each museum; referenced by visit.Museum_ID. The joins to visitor.Level_of_membership and visit.visitor_ID are spurious (accepted only statistically, no semantic basis).

Name.name: Name
Name.description: Full name of the museum; unique per row.

Num_of_Staff.name: Num_of_Staff
Num_of_Staff.description: Number of staff members employed at the museum (integer count, range 12-62).

Open_Year.name: Open_Year
Open_Year.description: Year the museum opened (2000-2012); stored as text but semantically a year.

table.name: visit
table.purpose: Junction/fact table recording a visitor's visit to a museum: how many tickets were bought and the total amount spent. Each row is one visit by one visitor to one museum.

Museum_ID.name: Museum_ID
Museum_ID.description: Identifier of the museum visited; references museum.Museum_ID (many visits to one museum).

Num_of_Ticket.name: Num_of_Ticket
Num_of_Ticket.description: Number of tickets purchased during the visit (integer count, 2-24).

Total_spent.name: Total_spent
Total_spent.description: Total amount of money spent on the visit, presumably in the local currency (values 19.98-320.44).

visitor_ID.name: visitor_ID
visitor_ID.description: Identifier of the visitor making the visit; references visitor.ID (many visits to one visitor). The secondary join to museum.Museum_ID is spurious (coincidental value overlap).

table.name: visitor
table.purpose: People registered as visitors/members of museums; each row is one visitor, linked to a museum via Level_of_membership and to their visits via visit.visitor_ID.

Age.name: Age
Age.description: Age of the visitor in years (values 25–56).

ID.name: Visitor ID
ID.description: Primary key identifying each visitor; referenced by visit.visitor_ID.

Level_of_membership.name: Museum ID
Level_of_membership.description: Despite its name, the values join to museum.Museum_ID, so this column identifies the museum the visitor is a member of, not a membership tier. The name suggests a membership level, but the accepted join to the museum lookup table contradicts that reading.

Name.name: Visitor Name
Name.description: Full name of the visitor (sample values are footballer-like names, likely placeholder data).
